name: Camera-Calibrated Learned Wave Propagation Model
definition: A learned model that captures real-world optical system behavior (aberrations, SLM non-linearities, stray light, limited diffraction efficiency) to replace numerical models like ASM in the PAGD optimization loop.
summary: This neural network replaces analytical propagation in holographic optimization by mapping phase patterns to multi-plane intensity images, capturing real-world hardware imperfections for more accurate gradients.
